messages:
natalie: Heads up — a VPC customer asked to self-manage rate policies (per-org + per-key + burst). Ops flagged safety concerns. Want to design a low-touch model that still protects shared infra.

sanjay: +1 on safety. Two high-level options: 1) let them push JSON to our control plane with strict server-side validation and global hard caps, or 2) delegate enforcement to their VPC edge/proxy (we only store policy metadata). Option 2 reduces blast radius.

maria: If enforcement lives in their VPC we lose some billing/console visibility unless we ingest telemetry. Could offer a telemetry sink and a webhook for policy updates. Also propose a `dry_run` mode so changes are visible before enforcement.

kevin: Ops concern: customers can author huge bursts and starve GPUs if on shared pools. For Dedicated we can map policies to tenant pools. For Private/on-prem we should either force local enforcement or require a reserved capacity commit for large burst windows.

platform-ci-bot: policy-validate job queued: job/validate-1781234567 (status: pending) :gear:

jordan: Proposal sketch: support a signed `customer_managed_policy` blob with fields: mode={dry_run,enforce}, `max_global_caps`, per_key caps, and optional `canary_percent`. Control plane only enforces `max_global_caps` (company guardrails); detailed per-key enforcement can be delegated to customer's proxy.

liz: quick sample policy I put together:
```
{
  "mode":"dry_run",
  "max_tokens_per_minute": 50000,
  "per_api_key": {"staging-": 10000},
  "burst_ms": 2000
}
```
We should validate against a schema and run safety checks (no > X tokens/min unless reserved).

natalie: Telemetry asks: surface metrics `token_limit_applied`, `token_limit_violations`, `policy_source` (control|customer). Console UX: show policy status, last validation time, and a diff/preview. For rollouts allow canary percent + automatic fallback to default policy if violation rate or error rate spikes.

sanjay: Require KMS-backed signing for customer policy blobs for Private deployments and store audit trail entries for every change. Also rate-limit policy updates and require admin approval for increases > 2x.

maria: For UX add a "policy preview" page with a simulated QPS impact and a 24h "test key" that applies the policy in dry-run and shows violations. That will help customers tune.

kevin: Ops asks we scope enforcement gating by deployment type: - Hosted: deny customer-managed enforcement (we control everything). - Dedicated/private VPC: allow customer-managed but only when bound to reserved capacity or when edge proxy is present. Can we aim for a minimal guardrail implementation next sprint?

natalie: Sounds good. I'm scheduling a 30m sync tomorrow 10:00am PT. Please bring: proposed JSON schema, validation job plan, UI mock for preview, telemetry metric names, and a short rollout plan (canary steps + fallback). I'll assign follow-ups after. :calendar:
